title: Testing and Evaluation of Large Language Models: Correctness, Non-Toxicity, and Fairness
findings: The models demonstrated varying levels of social bias related to religion. For instance, DialoGPT showed a high absolute bias rate (30.56%) for religion-related queries, whereas ChatGPT showed a 0.00% rate. This indicates significant differences in fairness performance across models and attributes, with religion being one of the measured dimensions.
